OpenAI's Preparedness Framework tracks "AI Self-improvement" (earlier "Model autonomy") with a
mix of public and internal evaluations: SWE-bench Verified on a 477-problem subset, SWE-Lancer,
internal pull-request replication (OpenAI PRs), MLE-bench (full set with pass@10 in the o1 era, a
30-competition subset with pass@1 from mid-2025, a revised 72-problem set from GPT-5.6), PaperBench,
research-engineer interview questions, OpenAI-Proof Q&A, an internal research debugging eval and
Monorepo-Bench. The High threshold is worded as "a performant mid-career research engineer".
